assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context
2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page

steps.title: One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".

assertionSteps.title: 3. And User A has entity FMO PORTAL ADMIN with owner role TEST_OWNER
4. And the Category editor shows fixture record 101 in the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" on the administration page
5. And the Category update POST returns HTTP 401 with an empty body and no TOKEN_INVALID_EXPIRED marker
6. When User A clicks the button labelled "Update" inside the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" on the administration page
7. Then the alert in the portal notification area displays exactly "Error happened, service is unavailable, pls check with support team: /api/auth/v1/fmo/admin/category/update: API request failed"
